name: Pipeliners - Organic SEO Snapshot 2026-09-16
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-16

# Summary
The snapshot of record for later comparisons, taken Sep 16, 2026 with all windows ending Sep 12 (30, 28 and 7 day windows, each compared with its own previous period). Published as an artifact and as PDFs (short and detailed); the PDF and KPI CSV were also uploaded to Keystone under Pipeliners > Assets > Documents. Nothing on the site was changed.

# Key findings
- Better: GBP leads more than doubled (24 vs 11 in 30 days; 5 booked); organic search leads rose to 4 with 3 booked.
- Worse: non-brand clicks fell 20% (39 vs 49); keywords on page 1 dropped from 59 to 33 (positions 1 to 3 rose from 16 to 24, positions 4 to 10 fell from 59 to 33).
- GSC Domain property, 30 days: 60 clicks (27 of them on the GBP website link), 26,447 impressions, average position 48.4 (was 44.3). Brand clicks up 50% (21 vs 14).
- GA4 organic: 174 sessions, 101 users (down 3% and 11%). GBP: 1,266 views (+19%), 20 calls, 29 website clicks, direction requests down 40%.
- Indexing: 104 indexed, 173 not indexed.
- Biggest opportunity: /florence/ for "florence pipe break repair", which slipped from position 4 to 15. City pages moving up: Mesa 48 to 39, Tempe 31 to 25, Sun City 34 to 24, San Tan Valley 33 to 25.
- Concern: growth comes from brand and GBP, not new rankings. Unconfirmed number (480) 969-7978 on Birdeye and one installer directory.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `README-snapshot-2026-09-16.md`: windows, sources and re-run notes.
- `kpi-snapshot-2026-09-16.csv`: 47 metrics by window.
- `technical-local-findings.md`: technical and local verification (own note).
- `Pipeliners-Organic-SEO-Snapshot-2026-09-16.pdf` and `-DETAILED.pdf`, plus matching HTML versions.
